title: Rules and signs
goal: Say what you have to and don't have to do, and what is forbidden: gitmek zorundayım, gelmek zorunda değilsin, sigara içmek yasak.

intro.text: **Have to** is `-mAk zorunda` + the endings of **to be**: *gitmek zorundayım* (I have to go). **Had to**, when circumstances forced you, is *zorunda kaldım*. **Don't have to** is *zorunda değilsin*: compare *gitmemelisin*, **you mustn't** go.

vocab.en: obliged to, having to (after an infinitive)
to put on, to wear (a belt, glasses, a helmet)

exercises.question: How do you say **I have to work tomorrow**?

exercises.label: *çalışmak zorunda*: I have to work, you have to work…
exercises.explain: The endings of **to be** go on *zorunda* and follow its back a: *zorundayım*, *zorundasınız*.

exercises.en: You have to wear a seat belt in the car.

reject.why: The last vowel of *zorunda* is a, a back vowel: *zorundasın*.

exercises.explain: *Zorunda* + *-sın* (or *-sınız*): the ending follows the back a.

reject.why: *Gelmemelisin* means **you mustn't come**. **Don't have to** is *gelmek zorunda değilsin*.
That means **you have to not come**. Put *değil* after *zorunda*: *gelmek zorunda değilsin*.

exercises.prompt: Kural bu: burada sigara içmek yasak.
accept: That is the rule: smoking is forbidden here.
[That is|This is|It is] the rule: smoking is [not allowed|prohibited|banned] here.
[This is|It is] the rule: smoking is forbidden here.
[That is|This is|It is] the rule: it is [forbidden|not allowed|prohibited] to smoke here.
[That is|This is|It is] the rule: you [cannot|are not allowed to|may not] smoke here.
The rule is: [smoking is forbidden|no smoking] here.

exercises.tr: Dün akşam geç saate kadar çalışmak zorunda kaldım.
exercises.en: Yesterday evening I had to work until late.

exercises.question: Your friend is ill and wants to go out in the rain. Which sentence tells her not to?

why.1: This means **you don't have to** go out: it leaves the choice to her.

exercises.prompt: Otobüs gelmedi, taksiye binmek zorunda kaldık.
accept: The bus did not come, we had to take a taxi.
The bus did not come, so we had to [take|get] a taxi.
The bus did not come and we had to [take|get] a taxi.
The bus did not come, we had to get a taxi.
The bus never came, (so) we had to [take|get] a taxi.

exercises.en: I don't have to go to school tomorrow.
There's no exam, I don't have to study today.

reject.why: *Değil* on its own is **he** or **she**. For **I**: *değilim*.
*Zorundayım* is **I have to**. **I don't have to** is *zorunda değilim*.

exercises.explain: *Zorunda değilim*: **I don't have to**. The personal ending goes on *değil*.

exercises.prompt: Is it forbidden to park here?
